entities.summary: Georg Christian Edler von Oldenburg Oeder was a German-Danish botanist, medical doctor, economist and social reformer. His name is particularly associated with the initiation of the plate work Flora Danica. Georg Christian Oeder was a performers & entertainers from Ansbach (1728-02-03, Ansbach–1791-01-28). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
